Description: Per-release decisions for the extraction stage: which parts of the release are ingested,
which are deliberately left out, and why. extract_plan.py reads this file; nothing here is
regenerated, so edits survive re-running the plan. All paths are relative to the release
root (the directory holding TLMC/) so this file stays portable between machines and can be
Every top level directory of the release must appear in either SourceRoots or ExcludedRoots.
extract_plan.py reports any that appear in neither, so a root added by a future release

ExcludedRoots.temp: Maintainer intake area, not normalised: 0 of 2640 audio files follow the '(NN) [Artist] Title.flac' convention and 2 of 237 album directories carry a date prefix. 118 of its 237 archives are alternate rips of albums already under TLMC. See IncludedSubtrees for the IOSYS backfill, which is the one part that holds albums found nowhere else.
ExcludedRoots.Software: Player and archiver binaries shipped with the release, not music.

ArchiveIsCircleDirs.various album/!MP3: Archives here are named after a circle and contain that circle's album directories, e.g. '!MP3/dBu music.7z' holds '[東方紅楼夢11] dBu music — 三面楚歌 ...'. The circle is taken from the archive name rather than the parent directory.
